videos.title: Hallobeanies / Meatman
videos.name: Hallobeanies / Meatman
videos.overview: "Hallobeanies": When the rest of the Bean Scouts head home for Halloween, The Jelly Beans figure Camp Kidney is the best place to spend the holiday. "Meatman": Chef McMuesli's is insulted over the campers criticism of his health food, so he gives a can of potted meat, which has some very unusual properties.
